tasks.title: Understand whose turn it is and what is blocking play
currentFlow: Scan the top initiative portraits and round.
Notice and open separate pending-response panels if present.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The current actor, round, and highest-priority unresolved decision are unambiguous.
currentProblems: Turn, scene, and blocking decision are in separate overlays.
The map remains visually dominant even while everyone is waiting.

tasks.title: Select or focus a controlled participant
currentFlow: Find the token or initiative portrait.
Click to select or focus it.
Use map highlighting to infer control.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The selected actor is clearly distinguished from current actor, inspected participant, and target preview.
currentProblems: Selection and current turn are easy to conflate.
Off-map reserves cannot be selected through the world.

tasks.title: Resolve start-of-turn conditions
currentFlow: Roll, skip, or remove each presented condition.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Required start-turn decisions settle in order before ordinary actions resume.
currentProblems: The modal is detached from pending-response causality.
Public waiting state and responder ownership are weak.

tasks.title: Discover what the selected actor can do
currentFlow: Select and right-click a token or expand Encounter.
Choose a source submenu or scan generic groups.
Inspect badges, tooltips, and disabled state.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Relevant legal and expected unavailable actions are visible and organized by intent.
currentProblems: Right-click and source chapters remain primary.
Generic and legacy action surfaces duplicate options.
Automation diagnostics crowd ordinary choices.

tasks.title: Understand why an expected action is unavailable
currentFlow: Hover or focus for a title/tooltip, or read the generic reason.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: A concise authorized reason and optional contribution explanation are available without diagnostics.
currentProblems: Some options disappear by source-specific filtering.
Hover/title copy and diagnostic details are inconsistent.

tasks.title: Declare a Move
currentFlow: Select participant targets or aim exact geometry.
Confirm declaration and wait for acceptance or responses.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: One authoritative Move declaration enters targeting, response, and accepted-result choreography.
currentProblems: Action discovery and target choice cross multiple unrelated overlays.
Exact map input is required even when participant cards suffice.

tasks.title: Choose one or more participant targets
currentFlow: Locate legal token reticles or modal rows.
Choose and confirm the required count.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Legal participant cards show relationship, distance, scope, and disabled reason without requiring camera work.
currentProblems: Equivalent target choices use reticles or bespoke modal rows depending on source.
Selection feedback is not shared.

tasks.title: Choose exact cells, area, direction, or placement
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The originating decision hands focus to a tactical lens and receives one validated spatial selection.
currentProblems: The map is always present rather than intentionally opened.
Focus return to the originating action is inconsistent.

tasks.title: Move a participant through the battlefield
currentFlow: Preview a route and movement budget.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Exact intended route remains visible through pending responses and settles only after acceptance.
currentProblems: Movement is one of many canvas gestures without a cockpit action origin.
Recovery and response status appear in separate overlays.

tasks.title: Choose an optional trigger, Interrupt, or Reaction
currentFlow: Notice one of several response panels.
Identify whether the current user may answer.
Choose an option or spatial input.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The newest blocking response is primary, public waiting copy is safe, and parent/child order remains visible.
currentProblems: Three response surfaces can duplicate one pending interaction.
Competing responses and nested causality lack one visual stack.

tasks.title: Pass, cancel, retry, expire, or force-pass a pending response
currentFlow: Wait for authoritative resume or terminal state.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Only authorized lifecycle actions are shown with consequence and expiry context.
currentProblems: Lifecycle controls differ by panel.
GM actions are mixed with responder options.

tasks.title: Declare an Ability action
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Ability choices use the same action and decision anatomy as equivalent rules sources.
currentProblems: The generic offer returns to a source-specific declaration panel.
Action state is split between context menu and floating panel.

tasks.title: Declare a Maneuver or Trainer Order
currentFlow: Choose Maneuver or Order source submenu.
Choose the entry and follow target flow if any.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Commands and Maneuvers appear by current relevance with source retained as provenance.
currentProblems: Source submenus dominate intent.
Orders and Maneuvers have separate legacy dispatch paths.

tasks.title: Use an activated or adjudicated Capability
currentFlow: Enter a Capability-specific action or adjudication modal.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The source uses generic action, bounded choice, and pending response primitives.
currentProblems: Two bespoke modals duplicate generic choices.
Adjudication is detached from response ordering.

tasks.title: Choose and throw a Poké Ball
currentFlow: Wait for a blocking result modal.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: The item choice, target preview, roll settlement, and accepted result share one causal flow.
currentProblems: The action starts from the target rather than actor intent.
The accepted result uses a bespoke modal instead of common history.

tasks.title: Send out, recall, or switch a Trainer's Pokémon
currentFlow: Right-click a Trainer for send-out options or open the GM sheet-spawn menu.
Choose exact placement on the map.
Use deletion or another action to approximate recall/switch.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Active, reserve, recall, switch, and placement state are explicit and authoritative.
currentProblems: Send-out exists, but recall/switch and reserves lack one coherent product flow.
Off-map team state is not visible in the encounter.

tasks.title: Inspect participant vitals, conditions, rules, sheet, or Pokédex entry
currentFlow: Find and right-click a token or focus initiative.
Navigate away or scan separate detail surfaces.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: A participant card expands into a privacy-safe inspector without losing encounter context.
currentProblems: Inspection depends on the token existing and commonly navigates away.
Public, owner, and diagnostic detail are spread across components.

tasks.title: Understand an accepted action and resulting state changes
currentFlow: Read a combat-log line or expand recent outcomes.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Action, response, changes, result, and settled history present once in causal order.
currentProblems: Prose log, generic history, splash, and VFX are parallel paths.
Duplicate delivery prevention is hidden from the visible chronology.

tasks.title: Request GM attention on a participant or cell
currentFlow: Use the presence panel or map gesture to request attention.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: A contextual finite signal identifies requester and focus without altering mechanics.
currentProblems: The action is split between a floating list and world cue.
It is unavailable outside full tactical view.

tasks.title: Recover an uncertain or interrupted command safely
currentFlow: Retry the exact intent when allowed.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Ordinary play remains blocked until exact retry, status, adoption, or abandonment reaches a safe terminal state.
currentProblems: A safety-critical workflow competes with ordinary overlays.
Its priority is not encoded in a common workspace state machine.

tasks.title: Understand reconnect, stale snapshot, reconciliation, or correction
currentFlow: Notice one of several state banners or correction notices.
Adopt corrected token and snapshot state.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: One prioritized system region explains known state, uncertainty, and safe next action.
currentProblems: Saving, reconnect, stale, control, correction, and action errors use separate overlays.
Correction can resemble ordinary accepted movement.

tasks.title: Start or end an encounter scene
currentFlow: GM uses the floating scene button.
Enter or adopt the scene name through route state.
All users see a separate scene banner.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Director command and public lifecycle summary update atomically with clear phase transition.
currentProblems: Public status and GM action compete as floating pills.
Scene objectives and phase context are absent.

tasks.title: Create sides and assign participants
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Sides, labels, status, reserves, and affiliations are managed in an explicit Director mode.
currentProblems: Only on-map placements can be assigned visibly.
The entry point is undiscoverable and mixed with Workshop settings.

tasks.title: Set, reorder, and advance initiative
currentFlow: Fill or edit scores and manual order.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Turn spine and Director corrections share one authoritative chronology without hiding player status.
currentProblems: Inspection and correction are split between modal and overlay.
Shortcut access is not visible.

tasks.title: Add, remove, reveal, or reinforce participants
currentFlow: Open Sheets with Ctrl+S and spawn a sheet, or delete an existing token.
Place the token on the battlefield.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Cast, reserves, hidden state, waves, placement, side, and initiative are one bounded Director workflow.
currentProblems: Add/remove is raw token mutation.
Hidden participants, reserves, waves, and reveal are missing as first-class tasks.

tasks.title: Inspect or change weather, terrain, rooms, and durations
currentFlow: GM adds/removes/ticks weather, terrain, and rooms.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Public field summary is persistent while authorized lifecycle changes live in Director mode.
currentProblems: Inspection and mutation share one modal.
The current state is not visible in the ordinary encounter hierarchy.

tasks.title: Place, remove, or clear battlefield hazards
currentFlow: Open Field Effects and select hazard mode/kind.
Place or remove cells on the battlefield.
Clear one type or all hazards.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Authored map hazards remain Workshop-owned; encounter-created hazards use authoritative actions and accepted presentation.
currentProblems: Workshop authoring and live mechanic placement share controls.
Hazard mode can displace ordinary encounter selection.

tasks.title: Correct HP, temporary HP, stages, conditions, damage, or XP
currentFlow: Complete one of six bespoke dialogs.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: A correction workflow labels intent, preview, authority, result, and audit history distinctly from voluntary actions.
currentProblems: Corrections look like ordinary token actions.
Six dialogs duplicate anatomy and originate only from map context.

tasks.title: Inspect and correct an accepted Move operation
currentFlow: Apply a correction to selected operations.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Structured history opens an authorized correction inspector and records a distinct correction event.
currentProblems: Entry depends on prose log rows and raw operation identifiers.
Correction floats independently of history.

tasks.title: Recover, cancel, or force-pass a stuck resolution
currentFlow: Retry, cancel, or force-pass when offered.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Director recovery acts on the ordered resolution stack with explicit consequence and audit.
currentProblems: Recovery controls vary by source-specific panel.
There is no encounter-wide stuck-decision overview.

tasks.title: Switch between setup editing and live play
currentFlow: Wait for shared map state to update.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Battlefield Workshop and live encounter mode have explicit navigation, status, and safe transitions.
currentProblems: The boundary is hidden in an admin modal.
Preparation and play remain the same route composition.

tasks.title: Manage battlefield visibility, shop interfaces, ground level, and dimensions
currentFlow: Open GM Admin or editing mode.
Change player visibility, shop interfaces, ground level, dimensions, terrain, or voxels.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Preparation remains a reliable Workshop workflow and is not duplicated into the encounter document.
currentProblems: Workshop controls are interleaved with live Director controls.
Some controls rely on hidden keyboard modes.

tasks.title: Inspect latency, VFX, render, operation, and automation diagnostics
currentFlow: Enable a debug flag or diagnostic audience.
Correlate traces, IDs, timing, and presentation manually.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Authorized diagnostics use one level-5 inspector and remain structurally absent for players.
currentProblems: Diagnostics occupy multiple world and persistent layers.
Legacy Move selection exposes automation details in normal flow.

tasks.title: Manage objectives, phases, hidden cast, waves, and reinforcements
currentFlow: Use notes outside the encounter UI.
Spawn/delete placements and edit sides manually.
Communicate phase/objective state out of band.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: Director state supports private setup, public reveal, objective/phase clocks, reserves, and wave launch.
currentProblems: This task has no coherent current product surface.
Raw map mutation is the only approximation.

tasks.title: Build and launch a complete encounter
currentFlow: Choose or open a map separately.
Assign sides and initiative in separate surfaces.
tasks.acceptedOutcome: One builder locks/rerolls cast, assigns roles/sides/stakes, chooses a battlefield, and launches a usable encounter.
currentProblems: Generation produces files rather than an encounter.
Launch requires manual cross-route assembly.
